purpose: External performance figures quoted from other publications, kept out of code so that they cannot be mistaken for values measured in this study.
provenance: Transcribed from RESEARCH_CONTEXT.md section 6 ('Literature / Comparison Models Already Used'). The underlying publications are not in this repository and their citations have not been confirmed here.
author_action_required: Attach the exact citation for each entry, or delete the entry.
Confirm each value against the cited paper's own reported figure.
Confirm whether the value is a held-out test score, a cross-validation mean, or a validation score; if the paper does not say, record 'unspecified'.
usage_rule: These values may only be placed beside a bootstrap interval as a descriptive comparison. They must never be used as the population mean of a one-sample hypothesis test: a single published number carries its own unreported sampling uncertainty, and was produced under a different split, class balance, and preprocessing pipeline (Reviewer 5, essential revision 1).
